input.query:
SELECT MAX(si.sale_date::date) AS sale_day,
       p.category, 
       SUM(si.total_amount) AS revenue,
       SUM(si.quantity) AS units_sold,
       COUNT(DISTINCT si.sale_id) AS transactions,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(si.total_amount) / SUM(SUM(si.total_amount)) OVER (), 1) AS pct_of_total
FROM sale_items si
LEFT JOIN products p ON TRIM(p.upc) = TRIM(si.sku) AND p.client_id = si.client_id AND p.location_id = si.location_id
WHERE si.client_id = '125' AND si.location_id = '125'
  AND si.sale_date::date = (SELECT MAX(sale_date::date) FROM sale_items WHERE client_id = '125' AND location_id = '125')
  AND NULLIF(TRIM(p.category), '') IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY revenue DESC

turns.question: Who shopped first on April 4th 2026?
turns.answer:
On April 4th, 2026, you had 584 transactions, but all of them were anonymous walk-in customers without customer identification. Since no customers were identified that day, I can't tell you who specifically shopped first.

Your sales data runs from 2023-01-01 to 2026-06-03, so April 4th, 2026 is within your data range, but those were all cash-and-go transactions without customer details captured.

input.query:
SELECT c.customer_name, MIN(si.sale_date) AS first_purchase_time
FROM sale_items si
JOIN sales s ON s.sale_id = si.sale_id AND s.client_id = si.client_id AND s.location_id = si.location_id
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id AND c.client_id = s.client_id AND c.location_id = s.location_id
WHERE si.client_id = '125' AND si.location_id = '125'
  AND si.sale_date::date = '2026-04-04'
  AND NULLIF(TRIM(s.customer_id), '') IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name
ORDER BY first_purchase_time ASC
LIMIT 1
